detailed_description: The Sleep Calculator estimates simple bedtime or wake-up suggestions from a target time, a selected fall-asleep delay, and fixed 90-minute sleep cycles. You can switch between wake-up mode and sleep mode, enter a time with the browser time input, choose a fall-asleep estimate of 5, 10, 15, 20, or 30 minutes, and review three suggested times for 4, 5, or 6 cycles with basic quality labels. The tool is a lightweight planning aid and does not detect actual sleep stages, optimize medical sleep quality, handle custom constraints, diagnose sleep issues, or guarantee that you will wake during a light sleep phase.
usage_steps: Choose wake-up mode to calculate suggested bedtimes, or sleep mode to calculate suggested wake-up times.
Enter the target wake-up time or bedtime in the time input.
Choose the estimated minutes it usually takes you to fall asleep.
Review the automatically updated suggestions for 4, 5, and 6 sleep cycles.
Use the displayed cycle count, hours, and basic quality label as a planning reference.
usage_examples: Estimate possible bedtimes for a planned morning wake-up time.
Estimate wake-up times after choosing a planned bedtime.
Compare 4, 5, and 6 cycle options using the displayed hours and labels.
Adjust the fall-asleep estimate to see how the suggested clock times shift.
